items.exampleEn: Many of the stalls at the festival are impermanent and will be taken down next week.
items.exampleZh: 節慶上很多攤位都是臨時性的，下週就會拆掉。

items.exampleEn: Water boils at one hundred degrees centigrade.
He always finishes his reports at the last minute.
items.exampleZh: 他總是在最後一刻才完成報告。

items.exampleEn: We found a cheap last-minute flight to Tokyo.
items.exampleZh: 我們找到一班便宜的臨時機位飛東京。

items.exampleEn: Saving money is part of our long-term plan.
items.exampleZh: 存錢是我們長期計畫的一部分。

items.exampleEn: Taxis are hard to find at rush hour.
items.exampleZh: 尖峰時段很難叫到計程車。

items.exampleEn: She found a short-term job for the summer.
items.exampleZh: 她找到一份暑期短期工作。

items.sentenceEn: Avoid driving into the city during rush hour if you can.
items.sentenceZh: 可以的話，盡量避免在尖峰時段開車進城。

items.audioEn: It will be thirty degrees centigrade tomorrow, so bring some water and a hat.
items.audioZh: 明天會到攝氏三十度，所以要帶水和帽子。

items.sentenceEn: Please don't change the plan at the last minute again.
items.sentenceZh: 拜託別再在最後一刻改計畫了。

items.sentenceEn: Our bank offers both short-term and long-term loans.
items.sentenceZh: 我們銀行同時提供短期和長期貸款。

items.stemEn: I can't plan that far ahead, so I only think about ____ goals, like this month's sales.
items.stemZh: 我沒辦法規劃那麼遠，所以只想短期的目標，例如這個月的業績。

items.stemEn: The meeting was canceled at the ____, just before it was supposed to start.
items.stemZh: 會議在最後一刻取消了，就在原定開始的時間之前。

items.passageEn: Kelly never plans her trips far ahead. Last month, she booked a last-minute trip to Japan and left the next day. Unfortunately, she arrived in Tokyo during rush hour, and the trains were so crowded that she could scarcely move. The weather was also colder than she expected: only five degrees centigrade. She had packed only summer clothes! In the end, she bought a warm coat and enjoyed the trip. Her friends say she should think about long-term planning, but Kelly disagrees. "Plans are impermanent anyway," she says. "Short-term plans keep life exciting, and changing plans at the last minute is half the fun."
items.passageZh: Kelly 從不提早規劃旅行。上個月，她臨時訂了去日本的行程，隔天就出發。不巧的是，她抵達東京時正好是尖峰時段，火車擠到她幾乎動不了。天氣也比她預期的冷：只有攝氏五度。她只帶了夏天的衣服！最後，她買了一件保暖的外套，玩得很開心。朋友們說她應該想想長期規劃，但 Kelly 不同意。她說：「反正計畫本來就不會永久不變。短期的計畫讓生活充滿刺激，在最後一刻改計畫正是樂趣所在。」

questions.questionZh: Kelly 抵達東京時遇到什麼情況？
options: 訂好的飯店客滿，沒有房間
班機延誤，晚了好幾個小時才到
遇上尖峰時段，火車很擠
整天下大雨，哪裡都去不了

questions.questionZh: Kelly 為什麼買了一件外套？
options: 她的外套在機場弄丟了

items.promptZh: 我們需要一個長期的解決辦法，而不只是短期的。
referenceEn: We need a long-term solution, not just a short-term one.
We need a long-term answer, not only a short-term fix.
rubricZh: long-term、short-term 是形容詞，放在名詞前（例如 a long-term solution）
「而不只是短期的」可寫 not just a short-term one、rather than a short-term fix 等

items.instructionZh: 用 rush hour 造一個句子，說說你上下班或上下學時的交通情況。
referenceEn: I always leave home early to avoid rush hour.
During rush hour, it takes me an hour to get to work.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 rush hour（例如 during rush hour、avoid rush hour、in the rush hour）
句子要說到你自己的通勤情況
